
{{alias}}( α, β )
    Returns the standard deviation of a log-logistic distribution with scale
    parameter `α` and shape parameter `β`.

    If provided `NaN` as any argument, the function returns `NaN`.

    If provided `α <= 0`, the function returns `NaN`.

    If provided `β <= 2`, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    α: number
        Scale parameter.

    β: number
        Shape parameter.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Standard deviation.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 1.0, 3.0 )
    ~0.978
    > y = {{alias}}( 4.0, 3.0 )
    ~3.911
    > y = {{alias}}( 1.0, 2.0 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( NaN, 3.0 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 2.0, NaN )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( -1.0, 3.0 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 2.0, -1.0 )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
